lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Terra Nova runs on Star Fossils, Max-kun — crystallised sparks of ancient dinosaur knowledge. And last night… they all vanished.

lines.speaker: vex
lines.text: Borrowed! The word is BORROWED. My Know-It-All Engine will do everyone's thinking from now on. Why learn, when my Engine can know it FOR you?

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: But working things out is the FUN bit! That's like eating a sandwich FOR me!

lines.speaker: vex
lines.text: Exactly. So efficient. And to guard the fossils, seven great champions now wear my marvellous Obedience Cogs. They don't think either. Bliss.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Champions?! Forced to serve without honour?! Little rex — this cannot stand!

lines.speaker: digger
lines.text: Righto — new plan, gang! Find the fossils, free the champions, and give that walking cuckoo-clock a lesson he won't forget!

lines.speaker: vex
lines.text: Adorable. Do try. The doors are locked, the champions are loyal, and I have SO much sitting down to do. Ta-ta!

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Then we begin with what we can reach. Fossil Canyon lies through the first door — no fossils needed. Step one of many!

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Tiny arms… BIG ideas. Let's GO!
